title: Ontological Uncertainty
case: Ontological indeterminacy and the emergence of physical structure
claim_tested: The proposed ontology would need a physical model with observable consequences distinct from competing accounts.
design: Conceptual evidence record only; no empirical estimator is available for this claim.
identification_limits: This is a philosophical proposal, not an empirical result
No numerical effect, confidence interval, or probability of cosmic emergence is estimated

result.conclusion: No natural experiment or numerical result identifies the proposed ontology. Quantum uncertainty and a structured vacuum do not derive the emergence of the universe.
